Each owner’s share of profit matches their share of what they put in, so the agreement records that this is deliberate.

15 articles, numbered from one after leaving out the ones that do not apply. Every cross-reference was resolved against that numbering, and a reference to an article that is not in the document stops the build.
The owners run the company themselves, so decisions are made by the owners voting.

No process for an owner to leave was agreed, so the agreement says plainly that there is no way out. Texas states that a member may not withdraw or be expelled, and an agreement that adds nothing leaves that as the term.
These shares allow an exact tie, so a deadlock article is included. It is left out when the arithmetic makes a tie impossible.
